subject: MARATHON: Lost Notes (cat) pilot mission — build + real live test
description: Pilot mission proving the whole chain: the definitive cat lab as a mission (fictional company, damaged/split files, 12-18 graded tasks covering cat display/create/append/concat/-n/-b/-A/-E/stdin/pipe/redirect, randomization tokens, hidden checks, bronze/silver/gold task tiers). Must pass REAL live testing: launch actual container on bc1, seed fires, exec the student solution path task by task, grader 0/N->N/N, badge awarded server-side, wrong-answer paths give rich feedback. Nancy on design, Chris on the student experience. Template locks only after this passes; then scale.
